answer_4.guideline: You are asked to check if the source language speech and its corresponding translated subtitles are synchronized, that is if the subtitle remains on screen for the right amount of time with respect to the corresponding speech. If the timing is wrong, move the timestamp of each subtitle such that the timing of the subtitle matches the timing of the audio.
